purpose: Writes and ends the tie between a person and a kind of contact, with race guards.
namedChanges: The imports are the peers `term-origin`, `term-slots`, `lws-relations`, `lws-session-bridge`, `relation-role`, `plan-record-hooks`, `contact-kind-model`, `contact-kind-catalogue` and the third-party `@tanstack/react-query`; `./kindRelation` (in partyTie) and `./expandRelationRef` are the unit's own.
`KindPredicate` and `KindEntry` (kindRelation.ts lines 86-103) are not here: `contact-kind-model` holds them, and `kindRelation.ts` imports `KindEntry` from it.
`GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN` (built when the module loaded) is `termOrigin()` at its two uses in `kindRelation.ts` (the master address of a type name) and the one in `partyTie.ts` (`masterTypeAddress`).

`export const DEFAULT_TIE_ENTRY_ID = `${GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN}/base/t/${typeTail(DEFAULT_PARTY_TIE_CURIE)}`;` is `export function defaultTieEntryId(): string { return `${termOrigin()}/base/t/${typeTail(DEFAULT_PARTY_TIE_CURIE)}`; }`; its two uses are `defaultTieEntryId()`.

`expandRelationRef` is copied from the app's `relationDoc.ts` (lines 35-39, 68-80, 82-84 and 133-135: `vaultBaseFromDocId`, `idOf`, `firstValue`, `expandRelationRef`) into `src/expandRelationRef.ts`, because `lws-relations` keeps those private and exports no `expandRelationRef`.

Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling, a measuring run or the host app are reworded; no code changed. One string literal carries the app's name: the lock name `gilbapp:kind-tie:<vault>:<contact>` (`tieLockName`), kept as it is (see the README, "Do not").
0.1.1: the entry point exports `expandRelationRef` (a one-line export of the existing file; nothing else changes), so that `stated-by` imports it instead of keeping a copy.
